Water is not your friend. This is most important the newer you are to throwing since it usually takes a beginner a lot longer to make a piece, that means the have to add move water over more time and it weakens the clay a lot. 300k views later... my Strawberry Baby is finally here. 🍓✨ To achieve this perfect ‘Strawberry Smoothie’ pink, I went through 6 glaze trials and 6 bitter failures. After 3 weeks of obsession, the 7th kiln finally revealed the hue of my dreams. But I didn’t stop at beauty. After testing this prototype, I decided to reduce the drainage holes by 15% for the final production batch. This refinement ensures a more intentional, gentle rinse for your fruit.
